run_sz_clang: run sz-clang.py to invoke pnacl-clang with is_cpp=False for C source compilation
run_sz_clang_cpp: run sz-clang.py with is_cpp=True to invoke pnacl-clang++ for C++ source compilation
run_sz_clang_sanitize: run sz-clang.py with -fsanitize-address to enable address sanitizer instrumentation
run_sz_clang_args: run sz-clang.py passing arguments directly to pnacl-clang for custom compilation flags
run_sz_clang_link: run sz-clang.py in linking mode to include dummy allocator definitions for instrumentation
